# Visiting From Space

> Visiting From Space is a technology PR agency based in Anaheim Hills, California. For 13+ years it has gotten technology companies real news coverage (not paid ads or advertorials) in outlets such as TechCrunch, Forbes, CNBC, Engadget, Wired, Mashable, Fast Company, Reuters, USA Today and Good Morning America. It has launched over 7,200 companies and is the #1 PR agency for CES exhibitors.

## Key facts
- Services: technology PR, product launch PR, CES PR, media relations, interview scheduling, press materials, coverage tracking.
- Who it helps: tech startups and established technology brands, B2B and B2C, including CES exhibitors.
- How it works: relationships with thousands of reporters, data-driven campaigns, an experienced PR team, and tracking every story.
- CES 2027 (January 6-9, Las Vegas): the agency contacts reporters attending CES and schedules interviews and booth visits for exhibitors before reporters' schedules fill up.
- Engagements: minimum of three months; pricing depends on campaign size and is quoted after a review of the project.
- Results are not guaranteed; reporters and editors make their own editorial decisions.
- Contact: through the contact form at https://www.visitingfromspace.com/contact.html
